acceptedAnswer.text: Mikołaj Piech is a founder and developer from Poland who designs, builds, and ships web apps, mobile apps, websites, and consumer software — from idea and product design through development and launch.

mainEntity.name: What apps has Mikołaj Piech built?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mikołaj Piech has built Just Mine (personalized children's books), Safe Labs (website for cybersecurity workshops), Trailo (AI travel planning), Subby (subscription manager), Doso (personal health app), and Solvee (AI homework helper, which he sold after 25k+ downloads). His products have reached more than 30k downloads overall and shipped on the web, App Store, and Google Play.
Just Mine, a web app for creating personalized children's books, was created by Mikołaj Piech. It turns a child's look, interests, family, and life into a custom illustrated story.

mainEntity.name: Who built the Safe Labs website?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Safe Labs website was designed and developed by Mikołaj Piech for cybersecurity workshops he co-organized for 12–14-year-old primary school students. The workshops covered phishing, cyberbullying, password and privacy protection, and verifying information online.
Subby, a subscription manager app for iOS and Android, was created by Mikołaj Piech. It helps users track trials and subscriptions to avoid unwanted charges.
Solvee, an AI homework helper app for iOS and Android, was created by Mikołaj Piech. It reached 25k+ downloads before being acquired in February 2026.
Doso, a personal health app for iOS, was created by Mikołaj Piech. It helps users manage medications, lab results, and symptoms with AI-powered insights.
Trailo, an AI travel planning product for web, iOS, and Android, was created by Mikołaj Piech. It covers flights, hotels, tickets, and hour-by-hour itineraries.

mainEntity.name: Does Mikołaj Piech build products for clients?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Mikołaj Piech works with founders and businesses to design and develop web apps, mobile apps, product websites, landing pages, and other digital products from idea to launch.
